{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric characters in 'revenue' column
non_numeric_mask = sales_df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False)
non_numeric_rows = sales_df[non_numeric_mask]

# Display the problematic rows
non_numeric_rows[['revenue', 'order_id', 'status']].head(10)"}
